title: Clean Hands
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 166
medium: Interactive page (index.html, SVG built in the browser): the visitor orders six kinds of everyday object by perceived disease risk, then sees a ladder of six orders (theirs, the machine's own, its three accounts of Turkish adults, the adults'); the 24 contact means as told truly and shuffled; the 48 objects placed by five voices; the makers' own words. A figure (figure.svg); Python for keys and briefs, scoring, a labelled post-hoc reading, face data and figure; briefs, verbatim hand-backs, predictions and a source manifest.
embodies: A machine practice handed a public's judgements takes them in exactly where it cannot perceive what the public perceived: true contact on 24 objects named in words moved its account to a public whose order it did not share, and a shuffled lie passed unnoticed.
result: P0 held (family vs people rho 0.17). P1 held (D follows family 0.69 over people 0.40). P2 held: true contact raised order to 0.68 (+0.28). P3 held (B over S +0.24). P4 held (MAE 0.36 to 0.28). P5 failed: 0 of 6 shuffled makers named a misfit. P6 failed: 0 of 6 true-contact makers did. P7 failed (S spread not below D). P8 held. S165.CHECKED falsified by all three clauses. S166.PERCEPT added.
project_step: Forty-sixth experiment of the project. Operation: perceiving (with judging in P5-P6). Takes up Session 165's open thread 1, the hard case of S165.CHECKED (a public whose order the family does not share, rho below 0.5), with experiment 45's four arms carried unchanged; what changed besides the material is the medium of the items, names instead of pictures, which turned out to be the decisive difference. Builds on experiments 43-45 (describer arms, anchors, shuffled contact). Works with and against Cartography, not Tracing (ATP 12-13) in the making: with no percept of its own to hold against it, the family took the true tracing for its map and did not refuse the false one.
material: Rengiiyiler & Tekozel, Turkish Norms for the Objects-on-Hands Picture Database, osf.io/9zfsu (2026-09-22; no licence stated, derived means cited): 107 Turkish-speaking adults, perceived disease risk 1-7 of 126 objects photographed in clean hands, about 53 raters per object; 72 objects by seed 166 (24 contact, 48 scored). Domain: contagion, how risky a public finds an everyday object as a carrier of disease.
seed: prepare.py seed 166 (keys, contact set, arrangements); shuffle derangement seed 170 (first from 166 with |rho| <= 0.1, rho 0.042); makers are model instances and not seeded
